title: Wait for executors that answer later, within a bound
goal: An executor that returns a promise is recorded and returned when it settles, ends as action.failed when it never does, and the coordinator waits for it over IPC
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a rejection is recorded as action.failed and returned; a granted promise through the gate records and returns its real result; a never-settling executor ends as action.failed after its bound; a worker-bound card finishes its job with the settled outcome
actions.act and approvals.decide wait for such executors within the tool's bound, not the 5 s IPC default, and Runtime.decide resumes waiting sorties even on a timeout
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
validation: A committed regression fails before the fix
escalation: A change of gate class or a material effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24 at 1.5 h agent from the review's findings; implemented the same day in about 1.5 h agent (stated, not measured).
